title: Beyond the Rubric: Cultural Misalignment in LLM Benchmarks for Sexual and Reproductive Health

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis comparing responses from an India-specific sexual and reproductive health chatbot against HealthBench's Western-centric automated grading rubrics to identify penalties for culturally grounded and appropriate advice.

Evaluating discrepancies between benchmark rubric criteria that expect US-specific legal frameworks, healthcare financing (insurance/USD), and dietary lists, versus chatbot responses tailored to the geographical and systemic context of India.
